topics.name: STRUCTURE OF THE ATOM AND THE PERIODIC TABLE

objectives.label: a)
objectives.text: name and write the chemical symbols of the first twenty elements of the periodic table

objectives.label: b)
objectives.text: describe the structure of the atom and write the electron arrangement of the first twenty elements of the periodic table

objectives.label: c)
objectives.text: explain the electron arrangement of the atom in terms of energy levels

objectives.label: d)
objectives.text: define atomic number, mass number, isotopes and relative atomic mass

objectives.label: e)
objectives.text: calculate the relative atomic masses from isotopic composition

objectives.label: f)
objectives.text: explain the position of an element in the periodic table in terms of the electron arrangement

objectives.label: g)
objectives.text: define valency and oxidation number of an element

objectives.label: h)
objectives.text: predict the type of ion formed from a given electron arrangement of an atom

objectives.label: i)
objectives.text: predict the valencies and oxidation numbers from position of elements in the periodic table

objectives.label: j)
objectives.text: derive the formulae of some simple compounds from valencies of elements and radicals

objectives.label: k)
objectives.text: write simple balanced chemical equations.

objectives.label: a)

objectives.label: c)

objectives.text: state the uses of alkali metals, alkalineearth metals, halogens and noble gases

objectives.text: explain the unreactive nature of the noble gases in terms of their electron arrangement
